newsitem.title: GERMANY: Two hurt as German apartment building collapses.
newsitem.headline: Two hurt as German apartment building collapses.

text.p: At least two people were seriously injured when a four-storey house collapsed in Duesseldorf following what police believe was a gas explosion early on Thursday morning.
A 60 year-old woman and a 31 year-old man were pulled from the rubble of the house. Police said they could hear knocking sounds under the rubble.
Some 15 people were registered as living in the building but six or seven of them were believed to be away on holiday.
Police evacuated surrounding buildings because they suspected a gas leak caused the explosion. Hundreds of Red Cross workers and firemen have arrived at the scene to search for survivors.
Residents said the house collapsed at 0100 GMT and they reported hearing a number of explosions. Dozens of windows in the surrounding area were shattered.
